title: VideoGeneralRequest
description: A whole-subtree replacement request for a video's General documents.

clear_chunks.description:
Delete the retained chunks a changed source invalidates.

The encoder input inherits this document when `sequences.parallel_encoder.input` is
null, so replacing the source makes every chunk stale.

input.description: Engine `Input` JSON; its path must be absolute when it states one.

output.description: Engine `Output` JSON; its path must be an absolute file in an existing directory.

source_path.description: The queued source a script input is told to open.
